draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.10, the 135th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 7th of 12 at TE. He went 121st overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (9th percentile). College production: 249 receiving yards in 2023, 10th of 12 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Seattle Seahawks. 34 career games and 23 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 5 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: season snap share 77.7% (93rd percentile), receiving td 6 (93rd percentile), team target share 14.9% (86th percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 tight end who played: 519 receiving yards against a median of 128, above the norm.
